regimeSub: Warsh Jackson Hole speech today as BOK hike aftermath and Nvidia beat collide with sticky 3.3% CPI.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh speaks Jackson Hole today (Aug 28 Reuters) → Fed divided on hike timing per Briefs Finance; gold bid $4655 on policy uncertainty ahead of speech
BOK Governor Shin's back-to-back hike to 3.00% (Aug 27) → signals gradual tightening with 3.3% GDP upgrade; KRW strengthens to 1371 as hawkish stance confirmed
Nvidia beats Q2 estimates (Aug 27 ETF Database) → KOSPI slumps below 6900 as Samsung/SK Hynix drop on chip rout spreading from Wall Street despite AI capex thesis intact
US stagflation data stack persists: Q2 GDP confirmed 1.5% (Aug 26 WSJ), July NFP -23k, CPI 3.3% YoY → ING notes slow PCE progress keeps Fed hike pressure elevated

headline: Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech today becomes pivotal as global CB hawkish tilt (BOK hike, ECB Schnabel) meets US stagflation data (1.5% GDP, 3.3% CPI) while Nvidia beat fails to arrest Korean chip selloff.
